hooks.name: Run property tests on haptics/validator save
hooks.description: Run relevant property tests when haptics or validator files are saved

action.command:
#!/bin/sh
# Determine which suite(s) to run based on the saved file path.
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_EVENT_DATA" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

WORKSPACE="c:/Users/Admin/Documents/ghost-touch"
RESULTS=""

# Backend: validate.py or test_validate_props.py
case "$FILE" in
  *validate.py*|*test_validate_props*)
    cd "$WORKSPACE/backend"
    OUT=$(py -3.11 -m pytest tests/test_validate_props.py -q --tb=short 2>&1)
    EC=$?
    RESULTS="Backend P9/P13: $(echo "$OUT" | tail -2)"
    if [ $EC -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "$RESULTS" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    ;;
esac

# Frontend: haptic engine / pitch / hit-test property tests
case "$FILE" in
  *hapticEngine*|*pitch*|*hitTest*)
    cd "$WORKSPACE/frontend"
    OUT=$(npx vitest run tests/hapticEngine.prop.test.ts tests/pitch.prop.test.ts tests/hitTest.prop.test.ts --reporter=dot 2>&1)
    EC=$?
    RESULTS="${RESULTS} | Frontend P3-P7,P11,P1-P2: $(echo "$OUT" | tail -3)"
    if [ $EC -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "$RESULTS" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    ;;
esac

echo "$RESULTS"
exit 0
